log_file.description: Path to the main log file.

enable_remote_commands.description: Enable or disable remote command execution (e.g., from Director or external sources).

endpoints.description: List of Endpoint objects (nodes in the cluster). Each endpoint defines a node's identity and network address.

name.description: Unique name of the endpoint (usually matches hostname).

host.description: IP address or hostname of this endpoint for cluster communication.

port.description: TCP port for Icinga 2 API/cluster communication.

zones.description: List of Zone objects defining cluster topology. Zones group endpoints hierarchically.

endpoints.description: List of endpoint names belonging to this zone.

parent.description: Name of the parent zone (for multi-tier hierarchies). Omit for top-level zones.

global_zones.description: Global zones (e.g., for templates, global hosts). Keys are zone names; values define `is_global` flag and optional `endpoints`.

is_global.description: Set to true for zone to be globally distributed (no parent required).

endpoints.description: Optional list of endpoint names allowed to run this global zone.
